description: A Turing-complete magic mod
The secrets of nature are revealing, in that dream palace shaped by consciousness
Truth manifests in hexagonal grids, the world is but your draft
No spells or mana needed, drawing geometry is the incantation itself
Etch the underlying logic of the world onto a small slate, then send it to a friend
They warned you, the end of exploring ancient secrets is obsession with geometry and unspeakable madness
The Turing machine opened its eyes in the honeycomb, and you drew its dream
Fold the truth of the universe into hexagonal honeycombs, then gift it to your dearest friend
Every stroke you draw rewrites reality; every line you trace is a prayer that blasphemes the gods
At the edge of logic, there are only mad hexagons and unspeakable alpacas
Ancient slates are waiting, that sacrifice belonging to Turing and geometry
Reduce magic to patterns, then elevate patterns to irreparable disasters
The runes of honey and wax are the source code of gods, and you are the only programmer
Sharing spells is sharing a unique kind of madness
In the honeycomb grid, the whispers of Old Ones are hidden, draw it, listen to it
The hexagonal grid is another syntax of the world, each stroke a whisper, piecing together ancient codes
What your fingertips draw becomes reality—no spells needed, just a mad intuition
Ancient legends seep from the cracks of geometry, spreading like ink on the slate
Draw your dreams into honeycomb patterns, henceforth holding self-made miracles in your hands
The edge of reason is a hexagonal net, where patterns come alive
Those unspeakable arcs are wordless ballads for friends, and unspeakable gentle atrocities for可怜 creatures
In every hexagon, a yet-unborn deity slumbers, waiting for you to awaken it with lines
You call it a spell, the slate calls it the fingerprint of your soul
Let madness be orderly arranged, let the indescribable have perfect geometric shapes
"Who reflects each other in the mirror, two forgetting one reed for a thousand autumns"
